subject: Founders Studio nomination — Orbit Labs eligibility check
messages:
From: Aaron Blake <aaron@bluerock.vc>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Founders Studio nomination — Orbit Labs

Hi Evelyn,

BlueRock is nominating one of our seed portfolio companies, Orbit Labs, for the Founders Studio promotional credit package. Orbit is building a memory-first assistant for developer docs and has already integrated an open LLM into their demo flow. We think Redwood's credits would materially help them with a 6–8 week POC.

Quick summary:
- Nominee: Orbit Labs (orbitlabs.io)
- Founders: Samira Khan (CEO), Luis Ortega (CTO)
- Round: Seed (BlueRock lead, May 2026)
- Ask: $5k in platform credits + help enabling self-serve issuance so they can onboard engineers quickly

Attached is a short nomination letter from BlueRock and Orbit's one-page product goals. Could you confirm eligibility and next steps? Happy to loop in the startup directly.

Thanks — appreciate it.
Aaron
Partner, BlueRock Ventures

Attachments: bluerock-nomination-letter.pdf (PDF, 92KB)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Aaron Blake <aaron@bluerock.vc>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Founders Studio nomination — Orbit Labs

Aaron — thanks for the nomination and the materials. I'll route this through our Founders Studio eligibility check. A couple quick asks so we can move fast:

1) Can Orbit share the legal entity name + EIN (or registration id) so we can validate against our sponsor rules?
2) A primary contact (email + role) who will claim the self-serve promo code in our console.
3) Confirmation that the company is not currently on an active Redwood paid plan (sponsors are for new entrants).

Rishi — looped you to run the eligibility checklist below and confirm whether we can auto-issue a promo code or require manual fulfillment. Neha — can you prepare a 5k credit SKU in the console (Founders Studio preset) so we can issue quickly if eligible?

If Orbit can share the items above today we can aim to have a promo ready by Tuesday.

Best,
Evelyn
Head of Growth, Redwood Inference

From: Samira Khan <samira@orbitlabs.io>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aaron Blake <aaron@bluerock.vc>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Founders Studio nomination — Orbit Labs

Hi Evelyn — thanks Aaron and BlueRock for the intro.

Quick answers below and attaching the requested docs.

Legal: Orbit Labs, Inc. (CA) — EIN: 94-1234567
Primary contact to claim promo: samira@orbitlabs.io (CEO)
Current Redwood status: not on a paid plan, used free trial in March (no active credits)

Attachments included: orbit-entity-docs.zip (Articles of incorporation, CA filing), founders-studio-goals.md (one-pager), team-roster.csv

We'd love the $5k promo so our engineering team can run a 6-week POC and evaluate latency/cost with your dedicated configs.

Let me know if you need any other verification. Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if that's helpful.

—Samira
CEO, Orbit Labs
https://orbitlabs.io

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Founders Studio nomination — Orbit Labs

Eve/Neha — ran through the checklist:
- Sponsor confirmation: letter from BlueRock attached — OK
- Entity verification: Articles and CA filing in orbit-entity-docs.zip — OK (matches EIN)
- Previous usage: trial in March — within policy (no prior Founders Studio issuance)
- Team size & stage: seed, team <20 — OK per program rules

Conclusion: Orbit is eligible for a standard Founders Studio allotment of $5,000 platform credits. We can provision a self-serve promo code that the primary contact (samira@orbitlabs.io) redeems in the Console.

Proposed next steps:
1) Neha creates the promo code in the Console with: 5000 credits, 90-day expiry, single-use per account. Set metadata: sponsor=BlueRock, deal=HS-10982.
2) I will verify the promo code against the HubSpot deal and mark the record as fulfilled.
3) Evelyn to respond to BlueRock/Orbit with redemption instructions and the link.

I can create the code now if Neha confirms the SKU is ready.

-Rishi
Director, Revenue Ops

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@orbitlabs.io>
Cc: Aaron Blake <aaron@bluerock.vc>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Founders Studio promo — Orbit Labs (next steps)

Samira — great to meet you over email and thanks for the quick turnaround. Per Rishi's verification, Orbit Labs is eligible for a $5,000 Founders Studio promotional credit.

What we've done:
- Neha created the promo code: FOUNDERS-BRV-2026 (single-use).
- Promo details: 5000 platform credits, expires 90 days from issuance, applies to self-serve sign-ups only.
- HubSpot deal HS-10982 marked as 'promo issued' and linked to the Orbit company record.

How to redeem:
1) Sign into the Redwood Console at https://console.redwood.ai/signup or create a new account using samira@orbitlabs.io.
2) Go to Billing > Promo codes and enter: FOUNDERS-BRV-2026
3) The credits will appear in the account immediately; reach out to support@redwood.ai if you hit any issues.

If you want a short onboarding session for your engineers to verify integration patterns (batching KV cache, cost controls), we can book a 30-minute office hours slot next week.

Thanks again Aaron and BlueRock — appreciate the intro and happy to support Orbit's POC.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Growth, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: founders-studio-goals.md
